title: Lack of approach to get the name of a inner class if inst_to_dict in @GDScript is deprecated
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.1.stable

### System information

macOS 15.5, M2 Max

### Issue description

Previously, if you have an instance `my_instance` of an inner class in any gdscript, say `class MyInnerClass:`, you can call the `inst_to_dict(my_instance)` function in the `@GDScript` global scope to get a dictionary containing a key `"@subpath"`. The value of that key is the inner class name, in this case, `"MyInnerClass"`. 

However, now it's said in the [documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_%40gdscript.html#class-gdscript-method-inst-to-dict) of `inst_to_dict` it's been deprecated. I wonder if there is an alternative way to get the string name of an inner class? Or if it is irreplaceable, then it probably should not be deprecated? Is there a certain plan of date/version when it will be totally removed, or it is just unmaintained for now but no plans for removal? Or at least can we have an alternative method for the same functionality?

In the documentation, it currently suggests using [JSON.from_native()](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_json.html#class-json-method-from-native) or [Object.get_property_list()](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_object.html#class-object-method-get-property-list) instead. 

However, neither of them work to get the name of an inner class. For example, running `JSON.from_native(my_instance, true)` raises `ERROR: Failed to encode a path to a custom script`. It does not throw the exception when running on instances of globally registered user defined gdscript classes, but it does not give the `class_name` either, it only contains the path to the script resource, and the name of the GDScriptNativeClass it inherits from.

Running the `my_instance.get_property_list()` method does not give any information about the inner class's name either.

### Steps to reproduce

As described above
